title: InvoCare Australia Pty Limited (IVC) - proposed acquisition of Norwood Park Limited (Norwood)

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Process Guidelines.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties.
ACCC discontinued its public review after InvoCare announced its intention to withdraw its takeover offer for Norwood Park.

body_sections.Summary: IVC announced on 16 January 2018 that it proposed to acquire 100 per cent of the shares of Norwood
